title: Goodwill Met on a Claim Refused under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans
content:
**What is met as goodwill when a claim is refused on a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans?** It turns on the refusals already standing on the plan inside the window over which routine work and goodwill drawn are counted, and on the goodwill visits the coverage allows.

Where no refusal entry stands on the plan inside that window and the coverage allows goodwill visits at all, the goodwill share of the figure the refusal is recorded at is met as goodwill and comes off, being 0.05 of that figure, or 5 percent of it. Where a refusal entry stands on the plan inside that window and the refusals in it stand below the goodwill visits the coverage allows, the repeat-refusal share of that figure comes off, being 0.02 of it, or 2 percent. In any other case nothing is met as goodwill.

## What is met in each case

| Refusal entries inside the window | The goodwill visits the coverage allows | What is met as goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| none | one or more | 5 percent of the figure the refusal is recorded at |
| one or more, and fewer than the goodwill visits allowed | any | 2 percent of that figure |
| one or more, and at least as many as the goodwill visits allowed | any | nothing |
| none | none allowed | nothing |

## Goodwill visits each plan allows

| Plan | Out-of-scope service visits handled as goodwill in a rolling twelve months |
|---|---|
| Manufacturer Limited Warranty | 0 |
| Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | 1 |
| Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | 1 |
| Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | 2 |
| Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | 3 |
| Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan | 4 |

**On a plan allowing no goodwill visits at all.** Neither of the first two readings is reached where no refusal stands inside the window, so nothing is met as goodwill.

**On a plan allowing 1 goodwill visit where 1 refusal already stands inside the window.** The refusals inside the window do not stand below the visits allowed, so nothing is met as goodwill.
